_about: The bridge deployments this module knows, in ONE place (config.rs reads this file at build time; use_deployment takes a name from it, a path or a JSON object of the same shape). A new bridge instance is a new entry here, never a code change. Sources: vault/DEPLOYMENTS.md, public-demo/RUNBOOK.md (not published) (sections 11 and 13), web/deposit/src/lib/deployments.js. To switch the app to another bridge, change `default` (the ONE switch). Each entry with a `bridge` block (and token `denoms`) also has a bridge code (logosbr1…, src/bridge_code.rs); a wallet adds a deployment that isn't listed here from its code, checked on both chains (src/bridges.rs), with no rebuild.

deployments.name: bridge-test-network-v5
deployments.label: Sepolia vault v5 (proof-checked, no release delay) → bridge test network (LEZ 0.4)
notes: Sepolia is an Ethereum test network: its coins have no value. Deposits are claimed on the bridge test network (LEZ 0.4), the team's own chain.
Withdrawals back to Ethereum are checked by proof on Ethereum.
Which bridge test network blocks count is the bridge operator's word until a finality proof for that chain exists; the vault's caps bound a wrong update.
The bridge's relay pays a public claim's fee: the account needs no LEZ.

v5 vault: RISC Zero's Groth16 verifier 3.1.0 checks every update and release proof (gate 0x0F3F80D37B1616C0E9B182D3A87FE4f6220715d1; updates only from its submitter); no release delay; deposit desk at 30 bps.
deployments.release_note: Withdrawals back to Ethereum are checked by proof on Ethereum.
deployments.release_detail: How: RISC Zero's verifier on Sepolia checks every update and release proof. Which bridge test network blocks count is the bridge operator's word until a finality proof for that chain exists; the vault's caps bound a wrong update.

deployments.name: bridge-test-network-v3
deployments.label: Sepolia demo vault v3 → bridge test network (LEZ 0.4)
notes: Sepolia is an Ethereum test network: its coins have no value. Deposits are claimed on the bridge test network (LEZ 0.4), the team's own chain, which is reset now and then.
This test vault was set up with a wrong starting value, so it can't pay ETH back out. Deposits can be claimed on the bridge test network; withdrawals come with the next vault.
The bridge's relay pays a public claim's fee: the account needs no LEZ.
v3 vault: deployed with its outbound starting state (g2State) at zero, so it accepts no update and pays nothing out; deposit desk 0x6b7F…DBc5 at 30 bps.
deployments.release_note: This test vault was set up with a wrong starting value, so it can't pay ETH back out. Deposits can be claimed on the bridge test network; withdrawals come with the next vault.
deployments.release_detail: Why: the vault on Sepolia was deployed with its outbound starting state at zero, and no update the bridge produces starts from zero. The bridge's way back (burn, update, release) is built and runs in the local demo; it needs a new vault.
